title: Decision heuristic for bespoke pricing & billing exceptions
creator: Priya Kumar
description: Create a compact, auditable decision heuristic and operational checklist for handling bespoke enterprise pricing and billing exceptions (commitments, invoice adjustments, marketplace offsets, and cost allocation edge-cases). The goal is to reduce ad-hoc decisions, shorten SLA for responses to finance/revenue/CS requests, and ensure consistent accounting tags and contractual compliance across Dedicated/Private/Hosted customers.
acceptance_criteria: A single-page decision rubric that maps request types to approval tiers, required artifacts, and owner for execution
A documented SLA matrix for first response and resolution time per priority and customer tier
A minimal dataset spec for finance to evaluate requests (cost delta, expected lifetime value, accounting tag) and a template intake form
A rollout plan for CS/Legal/Revenue including training checklist and one-week pilot with three customers
Implementation notes for Console intake route/backoffice ticket tagging and metrics to measure throughput and regret rate
scope_in_scope: Custom commitment sizing or term negotiation (discounts tied to monthly/annual commits)
Invoice line-item adjustments and one-off credits for usage anomalies
Marketplace credit application and mapping to customer commitment accounts
Cost allocation guidance for multi-tenant orgs: how credits/offsets apply across sub-accounts
out_of_scope: Technical billing system migrations or ERPs changes (Finance owns integrations)
Automated pricing engine changes - this ticket defines the heuristic, not the pricing logic implementation
Routine refunds below the threshold defined in current refunds policy (handled by Support)
decision_rubric: Score components: contract value impact (0-5), legal/compliance risk (0-3), precedent risk (0-3), customer strategic value (0-4), implementation effort (0-3)
Total score bands: 0-6 = auto-approve by CS; 7-11 = revenue manager review; 12+ = exec review with legal and finance sign-off
Artifacts required per band: CS justification note, finance cost delta spreadsheet, legal exception waiver (if >10k ARR equivalent), signed amendment for term changes
Timebox: revenue manager has 3 business days for band 7-11; exec review has 7 business days unless expedited by Director approval
escalation_path: Step 1: CS rep logs request via Console intake route with required artifacts (tag: pricing-exception)
Step 2: Automated triage assigns a numeric score and owner (CS auto for low score)
Step 3: Revenue manager reviews and records decision in ticket; if approved, Finance generates invoice amendment
Step 4: If exec review required, notify Legal and Revenue Director, schedule decision within 7 business days
Step 5: Post-decision: CS updates customer and attaches signed docs; Billing runs invoice adjustment and tags accounting codes
data_requirements: Baseline: documented current invoice(s) and usage window with cost delta calculation
Financial: estimated ARR impact, discount schedule, cost to serve delta (compute credits applied), and expected retention uplift
Accounting: GL codes to associate credits, marketplace offset mapping, and whether offset hits commitment or line-item
Customer context: contract copy, existing marketplace agreements, and previous concessions history
